q1.question: What if it rains after my windows are cleaned?
q1.answer: Don’t worry — we offer a 48-hour rain guarantee. If it rains within two days of your service and spots your windows, let us know and we’ll touch them up.

q2.question: Do I need to do any prep before the cleaners arrive?
q2.answer: Just make sure we can access your windows by unlocking any gates. We’ll carefully move small items like patio furniture as needed.

q3.question: Are you insured and bonded?
q3.answer: Yes. We carry full liability insurance and all team members are bonded, so your property is in safe hands.

q4.question: How do I get a quote?
q4.answer: Click the Get Your Free Quote button on this page or call us. We provide free, no-obligation estimates, often instantly based on your property details.
